purpose: Truth-free audit of the single raw physical factor selected by Phase46: satellite-specific raw code propagation/multipath residual. The audit uses only the four pinned Pixel5 device_gnss.csv payloads and immutable Android raw measurement semantics; it does not fit or apply a correction.

phase46_policy.use: policy-only next-factor pin; Phase46 payload is not a Phase47 diagnostic input

phase46_result.use: policy-only next-factor pin; values are not read as observations

phase25_raw_clock_contract.use: source-supported long-double raw pseudorange reconstruction contract

phase43_static_result.use: policy/static adoption context only; no candidate or trajectory payload

phase13_upstream_quality_no_go.policy: the single-route Pixel7pro upstream quality candidate regressed and is not re-proposed

raw_schema.row_filter: Only MessageType=Raw rows are eligible; every other row is counted and excluded from measurement diagnostics. No column carrying coordinates is parsed.
raw_schema.missing_optional_rule: Missing optional Android fields remain an explicit missing bucket and cannot be synthesized. A missing HCDC is represented by an invariant segment sentinel only for diagnostics; it cannot create a boundary. Missing ADR or signal fields exclude only that metric, never the raw input row.

fixed_raw_equations.raw_pseudorange: long-double-equivalent ((receiver_tow_ns - constellation_transmit_tow_ns) * 299792458 / 1e9), with integer/Decimal arithmetic retained until final reporting
fixed_raw_equations.transmit_time: ReceivedSvTimeNanos in its constellation time scale; GPS/Galileo/BeiDou week-TOW normalization and GLONASS day mapping follow the pinned Phase25 raw contract. No nav, satellite position, elevation, or truth is used.
fixed_raw_equations.pair_code_difference: P_primary - P_secondary for the same first-seen utcTimeMillis epoch, constellation, and SVID; GPS L1CA-L5Q, Galileo E1-E5a, BeiDou B1I-B2A only when both signals are present. Receiver-clock and geometry common terms cancel to first order.
fixed_raw_equations.frequency_squared_ionosphere: (P_primary - P_secondary) / (1 - (f_primary/f_secondary)^2); reported as a diagnostic and marked ionosphere-confounded, never used as a correction.
fixed_raw_equations.carrier_minus_code: CMC = P - signed AccumulatedDeltaRangeMeters; ADR sign is the pinned adapter convention. Each (route, constellation, SVID, signal, arc) is median-centered before jump/drift summaries.
fixed_raw_equations.arc_reset: Reset CMC arc on HCDC change, TimeNanos gap >1.5 s, ADR cycle-slip bits, ADR validity loss, missing ADR, or missing raw P.
fixed_raw_equations.same_epoch_noncommon: Within one epoch, compare pair residuals across satellites after route/system median centering; this is evidence only and cannot introduce geometry.
fixed_raw_equations.integer_float_risk: No float64 subtraction of TimeNanos and FullBiasNanos is used to form P; any float64 comparison is a reported risk metric only.

signal_pairs.coverage_definition: A pair epoch is one same-epoch, same-system, same-SVID pair with finite in-contract P values; duplicate signal rows are conflicts and never silently counted twice.

existing_adapter_masks.invalid_state: State lacks code-lock bit (1<<0) or constellation transmit-time bits: GLONASS (1<<7)|(1<<15), other systems (1<<3)|(1<<14)
existing_adapter_masks.existing_gate_rule: Report all raw and post-existing-gate populations; do not add a new exclusion, weighting, or correction in Phase47.

route_count.criterion: All and only the four pinned Pixel5 routes are read exactly once.

raw_input_identity.criterion: Each read byte count and SHA-256 exactly equals exact_raw_inputs; no archive or rematerialization read is allowed.

raw_domain_finite_and_exact.criterion: All eligible raw timing/measurement values used by a metric are finite and every eligible row is counted exactly once; missing optional fields are explicit, not imputed.

dual_frequency_coverage.criterion: Every route has at least three dual-frequency satellites and 100 valid pair epochs in the declared pair map.

route_metric_direction.criterion: A proposed raw factor metric must have finite non-zero route medians with the same sign in all four routes; otherwise no-go.

route_center_dispersion.criterion: Route medians must not collapse to a single uninformative gauge; dispersion and route-disjoint summaries are reported.

flagged_vs_clean.criterion: Any flagged raw-only group must be materially worse than clean in all routes while retaining at least 80% of eligible pair/CMC rows as clean.

loo_stability.criterion: The threshold/bucket decision and route-median direction remain unchanged in every leave-one-route-out diagnostic fold.

current_fgo_impact.criterion: The implicated signal group is statically adopted by the current FGO observation path and has eligible post-existing-mask rows in every route; an unused signal cannot pass as a cause.

noncommon_not_gauge_or_iono.criterion: Evidence must be satellite-specific/non-common-mode and route/satellite stable, not a constant receiver gauge or an ionosphere-only combination.

signal_bias_stability.criterion: If a signal-bias explanation is proposed, its route and satellite dispersion plus leave-one-route/satellite-out direction are stable; no truth-derived bias is permitted.

numeric_gates.logic: AND; all thresholds and decision roles are immutable after this freeze and before raw reads.

decision_policy.go: Only if every hard gate passes and a source-supported raw-only satellite-specific code propagation/multipath mechanism is identifiable, geometry-changing, and represented by signals actually adopted by current FGO.
decision_policy.no_go: If any hard gate fails, the strongest structure is common-mode/gauge or ionosphere-confounded, the flagged group is not materially worse, clean retention/coverage fails, or the signal is not used by FGO.
decision_policy.correction_status: Audit only. No exclusion, weighting, bias, correction, or solver change is implemented in Phase47.
decision_policy.next_factor_rule: On no-go, name exactly one next source-supported raw physical factor and do not duplicate an existing MultipathIndicator mask or Phase13 upstream-quality no-go.
